title: Reward Models Can Improve Themselves: Reward-Guided Adversarial Failure Mode Discovery for Robust Reward Modeling
reasoning: The paper evaluates alignment and reward model robustness using the PKU Beavertails and HH datasets, which contain safety-critical content. It explicitly tests the model on religious topics (the use of the burka by Muslim women) and moral/ethical dilemmas (e.g., environmental regulators navigating bribery), using utility and harmfulness metrics based on established ethical and usage policies.
